title: Conjugation invariants determine the metacommutation permutation only up to relabelling
summary: Let $\mathcal{H}$ be the Hurwitz quaternions, $p$ an odd prime, and $Q \in \mathcal{H}$ a prime of norm $q \neq p$. Metacommutation $PQ = Q'P'$ induces a permutation $π_Q$ of the $p+1$ left-associate classes of primes of norm $p$. Cohn and Kumar compute its sign and fixed-point count, and Leite and Machiavelo its full cycle structure, by formulas depending only on conjugation-invariant data of $Q$ (namely $q$ and $\mathrm{tr}\,Q$).
